title: agent-live event v1
description: One agent event. Death is tool_end with ok true. This file is the published shape of protocol/events.mjs SCHEMA. If they disagree, the code is the source of truth and this file is a bug.

tool.description: Required for kind=tool. Optional for kind=tool_end.

id.description: Pairing key. String and number forms of the same id are the same call.

ts.description: Event time in milliseconds. Required for every known kind.

realMs.description: Real duration of this call in milliseconds. Display only.

ok.description: Required for kind=tool_end. false is a failure, not a kill.
